title_en: Why Are You So Cheerful, My Son
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; I cannot name an author. 'Мерак' has no exact English equivalent; the phrase 'мерак си фрлив' is my reading as 'I have set my heart on'.

words_to_learn.en: I set my heart on (lit. threw longing)

lines.cyr: - Што си ми, сине, денес весело,
lines.lat: - Što si mi, sine, denes veselo,
lines.en: - Why are you so cheerful today, son,
why have you drunk so much?
Is it from sorrow, my son,
or from longing for a girl?
- From longing, mother, from longing,
for one beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: мерак си фрлив, мајко, по неа,
lines.lat: merak si frliv, majko, po nea,
lines.en: I have set my heart on her, mother,

lines.cyr: сон не ме фаќа за неа.
lines.lat: son ne me faḱa za nea.
lines.en: sleep does not take me because of her.
Today, mother, I fell in love,
with a beautiful girl, a young Macedonian.
Her hair is silk,
her figure like a fairy.
From longing, mother, from longing,
for one beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: мерак си фрлив, мајко, по неа,
lines.lat: merak si frliv, majko, po nea,
lines.en: I have set my heart on her, mother,

lines.cyr: сон не ме фаќа за неа.
lines.lat: son ne me faḱa za nea.
lines.en: sleep does not take me because of her.
Eyes blue as little coffee cups,
lips honeyed, sugary.

lines.cyr: За неа, мајко, се напив јас,
lines.lat: Za nea, majko, se napiv jas,
lines.en: For her, mother, I got drunk,
from burning love for her.
From longing, mother, from longing,
for one beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: мерак си фрлив, мајко, по неа,
lines.lat: merak si frliv, majko, po nea,
lines.en: I have set my heart on her, mother,

lines.cyr: сон не ме фаќа за неа.
lines.lat: son ne me faḱa za nea.
lines.en: sleep does not take me because of her.
Teach me, mother, advise me,

lines.cyr: дал' да го земам за либе?
lines.lat: dal' da go zemam za libe?
lines.en: should I take her for my sweetheart?
- Take her, son, take her,
may you be happy forever.

lines.cyr: Штом имаш мерак сине на неа,
lines.lat: Štom imaš merak sine na nea,
lines.en: Since you have a longing for her, son,
take her, son, for a wife.

lines.cyr: Мерак си фрлив, сине, на неа,
lines.lat: Merak si frliv, sine, na nea,
lines.en: You have set your heart on her, son,
take her, son, for a wife.
